sections.description:
Form Building, Reimagined for WordPress

Website forms aren’t just for collecting emails anymore. They’re essential tools for growth. Whether you’re capturing leads, scheduling appointments, collecting payments, or running surveys or quizzes, your form builder should do more than just gather data. It should help you convert, automate, and scale.

Meet FormGent – a modern, AI-powered form builder that’s built for performance, simplicity, and feels like a part of WordPress, not a separate platform.

FormGent lets you create high-converting forms of any kind—conversational form, multi-step form, payment, surveys, and more, in just a few clicks. Simply drag and drop, or describe it with AI to generate your form in seconds. You can also connect tools like Google Sheets, Mailchimp, Zapier, or Zoho to automate your entire workflow—no code, no complexity.

And best of all? The most premium features aren’t locked behind a paywall.

  • Premium Features — FREE
  • AI Form Builder — create forms in seconds
  • Drag, Drop & Done — as easy as it sounds
  • Ready-Made Templates — build smarter, not longer
  • Feels like WordPress — no learning curve, no clutter

So if you’re ready to build forms that are faster, smarter, and easier, you’re in the right place.

What You Can Build With FormGent

With FormGent, you can create any type of form your website needs. Here are a few practical examples to spark your imagination, each with a step-by-step guide.

  • Create Conversational Forms That Boost Engagement
  • Build a Job Application Form Like a Pro in Just 4 Steps
  • Step-by-Step Guide to Crafting an RSVP Form
  • How to Collect Meaningful Feedback

Need Something Else? You Can Build That Too

  1. Contact Form
  2. Lead Generation Form / Newsletter Signup
  3. Payment Form / Payment Collection
  4. Multi-Step Form
  5. Survey Form
  6. Customer Testimonials Form
  7. Quote Request Form
  8. Product Order Form
  9. Support Ticket Form
  10. Course Registration Form
  11. NPS (Net Promoter Score) Survey
  12. Student Feedback Form
  13. Volunteer Sign-Up Form
  14. Employee Onboarding Form
  15. Workshop Registration Form
  16. Post-Purchase Feedback Form
  17. Scholarship Application Form
  18. Employee Leave Request Form

Key Features at a Glance

  1. Conversational form
    FormGent allows building conversational forms that not only boosts engagement but also increases completion rate.
    Bonus: It saves your incomplete submission data in the back for you to find what you might be missing.

  2. Multistep form
    Don’t bore your customers with boring and lengthy forms. Break underwhelmingly long forms into multi-step forms using the page breaks and improve user experience.
    Classic or Conversational, make your visitors’ interaction enjoyable.

  3. Conditional Logic
    Deliver personalized form experiences by showing or hiding fields based on user input. Create dynamic forms that adapt in real time, improving engagement and data quality.

  4. AI Form Creation
    Effortlessly create intelligent, fully functional forms from a simple prompt. Save time and eliminate guesswork with support for both conversational and classic form formats.

  5. Integration
    FormGent seamlessly connects with your favorite tools like Google Sheets, Zapier, Mailchimp, Zoho CRM, PayPal, Stripe, Google Maps, and more. So every form submission can instantly trigger the next action, automate workflows, and keep your business moving.

  6. Payment
    Receive your e-commerce product orders and collect online payments with a highly customized product order and payment collection form. Seamlessly integrate FormGent with popular payment options.

  7. Quiz
    Formgent allows you to turn any form into an interactive quiz with scoring and result display. This is perfect for educational tools, assessments, knowledge checks, or fun interactive content.

  8. Save incomplete data ( Conversational form )
    FormGent saves incomplete data with no-code forms and AI-supported form-building features. Save partial form data right away. Prevent loss of progress, save your information. Capture unfinished form submissions.

  9. Analytics
    Track how your forms perform with built-in analytics. Monitor submission rates, field drop-offs, and user behavior to optimize your forms for better conversions and user engagement, without relying on external tools.

What You Get for FREE

After reviewing the free features, you’ll say – “Are you out of mind?” It seems like madness, but you know, “Great things come from madness”.

  1. Multi-step Forms / Page Break
  2. Conversational Form
  3. Conditional Logic
  4. iFrame Embedding
  5. FormGent AI
  6. Payment System
  7. Google Sheets Integration
  8. Zapier Integration
  9. Directorist Integration
  10. WPML Integration
  11. MailChimp Integration
  12. PayPal Integration
  13. Stripe Integration
  14. Google Maps Integration

Pro Isn’t Required. But It’s Worth It

We care about your single penny, that’s why we packaged FormGent in a solid way. Our free plan will cover almost every need about the term “Form”. But if you really want a no compromise solution, here is the Pro solution for you.

  1. Digital Signature
  2. Webhooks
  3. Conditional Email
  4. Analytics
  5. Save Incomplete Data
  6. More Coming

Grow with FormGent

The features list has just begun. We’re continuously developing our product with exciting features. And surely this will not be possible without your support. Feel free to submit your feedback. Let’s grow together and build an awesome form builder with FormGent.

For a clear vision, you can check out our roadmap section.

From Idea to Form — In Just a Few Seconds

Building forms shouldn’t feel like work. With FormGent, it’s as easy as having a conversation.

  1. Tell us what you need — Say something like: “I need a contact form with name, email, and message.”
  2. Let our AI do the heavy lifting — It instantly creates the form for you, with the right fields and settings.
  3. Make it yours — Tweak the design with drag & drop, then publish it anywhere using a shortcode or block, or URL.

That’s it. No tech headaches, no starting from scratch. Your form is done in seconds.

Love FormGent? You’ll Love These Too

FormGent is proudly developed by wpWax, the team behind several top-rated WordPress plugins:

👉 Directorist – Build any directory or classified ads listing sites. It’s the only directory plugin with 20K+ active users in its niche!

👉 HelpGent – Your Ultimate Help Agent for Video, Voice, and Text Messaging with Screen Record Facility

👉 Legal Pages – Privacy Policy, Terms & Conditions, GDPR, CCPA, and Cookie Notice Generator

👉 Product Carousel Slider & Grid Ultimate for WooCommerce – The most intuitive solution to make your eCommerce site visually appealing by creating WooCommerce product carousel, sliders, or grids easily

👉 Logo Showcase Ultimate – Ultimate logo showcase plugin to create a responsive logo carousel, logo slider & logo grid and display unlimited clients, partners, sponsors’ logos

Privacy Policy

FormGent uses Appsero SDK to collect some telemetry data upon user’s confirmation. This helps us to troubleshoot problems faster & make product improvements.

Appsero SDK does not gather any data by default. The SDK only starts gathering basic telemetry data when a user allows it via the admin notice. We collect the data to ensure a great user experience for all our users.

Integrating Appsero SDK DOES NOT IMMEDIATELY start gathering data, without confirmation from users in any case.

Learn more about how Appsero collects and uses this data.

Support & Documentation

FormGent comes with detailed, step-by-step documentation and helpful video tutorials to guide you. Join our growing Facebook community where FormGent users share ideas and help each other grow faster. And if you ever need direct help, our friendly support team is just a message away.
sections.faq:
Is FormGent compatible with all WordPress themes?

Yes, FormGent works seamlessly with any modern themes in the market.

Can I create multi-step or conversational forms with FormGent?

Yes, FormGent supports both multi-step and conversational forms to provide a rich and engaging user experience.

Can I use FormGent for surveys or quizzes?

Yes, FormGent supports advanced functionalities for building surveys, quizzes, and polls effortlessly.

Can I use FormGent with a Page Builder?

Absolutely! FormGent is designed to be fully compatible with all major page builders, ensuring seamless integration without any interference.

Are there advanced customization options for fields and layouts?

Yes, FormGent provides extensive options for customizing fields, layouts, and styling to match your brand.

Is FormGent optimized for mobile?

Absolutely! FormGent is designed with a mobile-first approach.

Does FormGent support payment forms?

Yes, FormGent supports Stripe and PayPal payments.

How does FormGent handle user data?

FormGent adheres to GDPR standards, and you can add a GDPR consent field to your forms.

How can I get support if I have an issue?

You can visit our Support Page for help or contact our support team directly. We’re here to assist you with any issues or questions you may have.

Do I need any coding knowledge to use FormGent?

No, FormGent is beginner-friendly and does not require coding knowledge to create or customize forms.

Can I track form submissions and user engagement?

Absolutely! FormGent provides built-in analytics to track form submissions, user interactions, and more in the All Responses section.
